svg.title: Commissioning test of the cold-room controller
svg.desc: In the baseline and in the changed-load run the temperature stays between 1.35 and 2.98 degrees Celsius from 40 seconds, inside the required 1 to 3 degrees, and every ON and OFF period lasts at least 8.0 seconds.
svg.text: Commissioning test of the complete cold-room controller
Simulator runs of this project · baseline door 60–90 s and changed load door 60–105 s · numbers answer the predictions
Shortest ON and OFF periods: 8.0 s
